authoring_guidance: Parts concatenate exactly with no implicit separators. Include the whitespace required for headings, paragraphs, tables and other Markdown at every part boundary; a new heading needs a preceding newline. Keep local caveats associated with the same option. Slot values already contain some units: show points/currency/unit labels once and preserve minor-unit qualifiers; never infer missing fees, quote scope or totals. Describe source carriers as reported carriers unless operating-carrier evidence is explicit. Use exact supplied claim-catalog proposition names where applicable, rather than inventing synonymous machine labels; do not force an inapplicable proposition. Briefly explain why each selected variant is useful and distinct without adding eligibility or valuation policy. Explain coverage limitations in plain language while retaining mandatory source-bound disclosures. You still own layout, ordering and prose.
